notes: Four articles emptied: one before a name (rule 23), one by the free genitive ὑμῶν (rule 20), one by the 's genitive in this man's blood (rule 20) and one by the attributive demonstrative (rule 38).
The cognate dative Παραγγελίᾳ is aligned to strictly rather than joined to the verb, both elements having their own English word (rule 2).
